race.comment: OVER THE LIMIT (2) has recently been bought out of NSW after racing consistently last season. He resumes with a recent trial win under his belt, and will have the blinkers on for the first time. Expect a stronger gelding this term, and he is good enough to overcome a wide draw to win fresh up. TROOPER SAM (3) ran the odd good race last season, and he will be suited to 870m fresh up. He cops a tricky gate, but can figure in the top 3. MEAN MAHAL (1) is a local gelding given plenty of time before making his debut. He has won each of his public trials, and his latest was his best performance. He will be ready to rumble. MISHPAT (6) won't lack fitness, and can make the most of her good draw early on. She should appreciate the drop back from 1100m, and a return to form is on the cards. TROY BOY (8) improved sharply from a sound effort for fifth fresh, to finish runner-up by a neck at Warwick 2 weeks ago. He gets a big swing in his draw, and can go one better.
